name: resume
description: Two turns meant to run as two SEPARATE processes, the second passing --conversation <id> from the first (docs/02 §6: lossless resume, num_turns and step_index continue). Turn 1's oneshot process answers a 'remember N' style prompt; turn 2, in a brand-new process resuming the same conversation id, answers as if it still had that context (agy.mjs replays turns_played from AGY_FAKE_STATE_DIR/<conversation_id>.json rather than truly remembering, but the observable contract — num_turns=2, conversation_id unchanged, response text proving turn 2 ran — is identical to what real agy showed in .spike/out/resume.out).
